title: Message Board — visual/manual rubric
setup: npm install; npm run dev (or start backend+frontend separately). Open the app in TWO browser windows side by side.

items.criterion: Messages render as a readable list; history loads on first paint without user action.
Posting: input clears on submit and the message appears immediately, with no full page reload.
Realtime: a message posted in window A appears in window B within ~1s without reloading B.
